$comment: Addresses and checksums are resolved live: the releases table in Supabase first, then the GitHub release. This file is the fallback and the source of everything those two have no opinion about — wording, install commands, ordering. Regenerate the inline copy in downloads.html with scripts/sync-downloads-html.mjs.

highlights: Reasoning loop: falsifiable hypotheses, predictions checked against observation, explicit fact / inference / hypothesis labels
Senior-Engineer Standards: understand the system before changing it, think in blast radius, trace the full path to failure modes
Coding mode runs one Build Lens — the offensive posture loads only when security mode is enabled in settings
42 model providers — cloud, local and fully custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Permission gate with a hard safety denylist that no rule can override

builds.title: REX.0.3.8.exe
builds.subtitle: Portable single file. No install, no registry writes — run it from a USB stick.

builds.title: REX.Setup.0.3.8.exe
builds.subtitle: NSIS installer — Windows 10/11, x64. Adds a Start-menu entry and file associations.

builds.title: rex-0.3.8-linux-x64.tar.gz
builds.subtitle: Distro-agnostic tarball. Extract anywhere and run ./rex — no package manager involved.

builds.title: rex_0.3.8_amd64.deb
builds.subtitle: Debian / Ubuntu / Kali. Installs to /opt/REX, puts rex on your PATH, registers a desktop entry.

builds.title: REX-0.3.7.dmg
builds.subtitle: Apple silicon and Intel. Build target is configured; a signed artifact has not been published yet.
builds.note: Packaging is wired up in package.json — build it yourself on a Mac until a notarised DMG ships here.

builds.title: Build from source
builds.subtitle: Clone the monorepo and run it in dev mode with a hot-reloaded renderer.
builds.install:
git clone https://github.com/rxdsec634/REX.git
cd rex
npm install
npm start

projects.name: REX Agent
projects.blurb: The full local-first offensive-security and engineering agent — recon, taint analysis, payload construction, agentic loop, 23 providers, permission gate, desktop control, browser automation. This is the flagship; the builds above are its releases.

projects.name: Rex Browser
projects.blurb: An AI browser for Windows, Linux and Android with the Rex agent built in. Ad and tracker blocking, malware and phishing protection, HTTPS upgrades and verified auto-updates. Browsing is free; the agent uses your RXDSEC account.
